comment: Verbatim transcription from the arXiv v5 PDF (fetched 2026-09-01), text layer cross-read against a page render. The column order of every list is the (h,k) column order of the table: (1,0.1), (1,0.2), (1,0.5), (1,1), (1.5,1). The analytical rows are printed to four decimals and appear truncated rather than rounded (e.g. <V> at (1,0.5): exact -0.25989, printed -0.2598; <H1> at (1,1): exact 0.25989, printed 0.2598). <E1> = <H1> + <V> per the table caption. Values are model energies (hbar = 1, arbitrary units). The (1,1) qasm_simulator row differs from Table I's (1,1) qasm_simulator row (separate simulator runs).
